Arunachal Border Claims: MP Calls Reports Misleading, Cites Verification Post-Monsoon

Reports of a new Chinese incursion into Arunachal Pradesh have been described as misleading by a Rajya Sabha Member. The MP stated that verification of such claims would occur after the monsoon season. This follows a pattern of recycled claims about India-China border issues, often using old or unrelated footage.
